steps.eval: (() => { const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('.trim-blank.cut:not(.outside)')].sort((a, b) => b.getBoundingClientRect().width - a.getBoundingClientRect().width); window.__i = els[0].dataset.blank; window.__coupes = A.state.project.montage.blanks.filter(b => b.cut !== false).length; window.__duree = A.model.montageDuration(); return window.__i; })()

realclick.at: (() => { const el = document.querySelector(`[data-blank="${window.__i}"]`); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2 }; })()
